# Algebra 1 — A Four-Week Course

> A free, self-paced Algebra 1 course with 29 short lectures, unlimited practice, and an interactive tutor. No account needed.

## Course weeks

- [Week 1 — Expressions and linear equations](/weeks/1)
- [Week 2 — Inequalities, functions, and linear graphs](/weeks/2)
- [Week 3 — Systems, exponents, and polynomials](/weeks/3)
- [Week 4 — Factoring, quadratics, and radicals](/weeks/4)

The course also includes two homeworks, an 8-question midterm, and a 10-question final. Individual lessons are available at `/lectures/{id}`.
